run-subtitle: Press Enter to run as a shell command

file_manager.label: File manager
file_manager.description: Command used to open directories. Defaults to xdg-open, which follows the desktop default; set it to nautilus, thunar, dolphin, etc. to skip the indirection.

file_opener.label: File opener
file_opener.description: Command used to open files. Also xdg-open by default.

max_results.label: Maximum results
max_results.description: Maximum number of completion entries listed at once.
